title: Patrick Jackson's theory of spheres as an alien global defense system

tellings.quote: Well, Patrick's theory is that these spheres are part of a global defense system by some alien civilization to keep the bad guys out of Earth.

plain: The idea is that mysterious spheres seen in the sky are part of a worldwide defense system set up by an alien civilization to keep the bad guys away from Earth. Ross Coulthart, an Australian investigative journalist, relays this as the theory of a man named Patrick Jackson. If true, it would mean someone out there is protecting the planet rather than threatening it.
